**Key findings:** Cáceres has exactly one Michelin-starred restaurant — [Atrio](https://atriocaceres.com/en/) with **3 stars** (gained 2023, revalidated 2026). There are no 2-star restaurants anywhere in Extremadura. Atrio's tasting menu runs €295/person with wine pairings at €100–170. The wine cellar (37,000 bottles, Michelin Sommelier Award winner 2025) is as much a destination as the food — and famously the site of a 2021 €1.6M heist. Versátil (1 star, Zarza de Granadilla, 65 km away) is the only other starred option in the province.
